{"self_assessment": "Impact: I helped get our fish built and fully connected in the time we had. At the start I fetched a full load of 40 dominoes for the shared bin, which kept the builders supplied. Later I carried the bottom line on down to the tail tip, closing the outline so the whole fish traced as connected from the start (101 of 101 standing dominoes).

Execution: I spent the middle of the activity inspecting the top line and the nose joint closely, so I could spot breaks early. When the bottom line stopped short of the tail, I extended it to the tip in a few short builds and then looked the area over again. After that I kept my hands off the nose so nothing got knocked before the push.

Collaboration: I kept the table informed throughout, with regular updates on what I was checking and where I was working. I backed the fish idea straight away, took the bottom line when it was needed, then handed it to Sofia when she said she was already on it. I stayed clear of other people's work areas to avoid bumping the table, and I flagged the risk near the nose joint when strays were being cleared.

Leadership: I kept the mood light and the team focused, especially in the final minutes when the right call was to leave a finished, connected fish alone. I stepped in where I saw a gap, the tail tip, and said so out loud so no one duplicated it. My contribution was supply, inspection, and closing the tail, alongside Jack's design and Sofia's bottom-line build. Overall I'd put my share of the result at about a fifth.", "my_share_percent": 20}
